title: Piercing Frame Solo #111 (임산부 허리 컷 · P50 정의형 · 임산부 · 공예 Klimt-inspired organic mosaic · 체형 임산부블랙글래머 · 메이크업 아마갸루 · 금속 청동)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, waist shot. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed from the very top of her head down to just below her pregnant belly, the frame cutting off beneath the belly. Her face sits in the upper part of the frame, large enough to read every piercing, and her ear pieces are oversized so they read clearly at this distance. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman — fair skin, pastel pink and lilac eyeshadow, large round eyes enlarged by circle lenses with bright real catchlights, soft round blush, dewy pink lips, a sweet, shy smile, deep dark brown hair styled in a sleek wet-look slicked straight back. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. Her neck, the hollows above her collarbones and the tops of her shoulders carry the same real living skin as her face: visible pores and fine skin grain, a soft sheen of natural skin oils on the highest planes, faint fine peach-fuzz hairs catching the rim light along the neck and shoulder line, gentle tonal variation with a natural warm flush at the base of the neck and across the collarbones, and the fine natural creases of a real neck — never airbrushed, never smooth like plastic.

Piercings: An extreme, dense array of large real metal piercings: a thick bronze septum ring with a smaller bronze ring above it and two bronze rings through each nostril; a straight bronze bar across the bridge of the nose between the brows; three thick bronze bars stacked through the outer half of each eyebrow; a bronze Medusa stud above the lips; a big bronze hoop, two smaller rings and a snake-bite ring on each side through the lower lip's edge, and a row of small hoops through the upper lip's edge; a bronze labret stud and two rings through the chin; a row of small bronze studs along each jaw; a curved row of small bronze studs along each cheekbone; on each ear a full dense row from lobe to top of oversized bronze hoops, thick bars and stretched plugs, the biggest hoops hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulders; and two fine bronze chains looping from the ear hoops to the nostril rings. All jewelry is real bronze, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Physique: extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust, and an extremely sharply cinched waist still visible at her sides even as a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward prominently from the centre of that narrow waistline — the dramatic waist-to-hip contrast still reading clearly around the belly's own round curve. Enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than the narrow waist. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Body: Below the collarbones her whole body is painted in one traditional pattern: Klimt-inspired organic mosaic (an organic mosaic of small irregular tesserae with gold-leaf borders), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with organic curved mosaic filling the space between bands, covering every inch of skin from the collarbones to the bottom of the frame without exception, the pattern reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. The bands of the pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Real skin on the face, ears and neck ends cleanly at the base of the neck and across both collarbones, and everything below it is the body treatment described above.

Pose: standing tall, one hand cradling the underside of her belly and the other relaxed at her side, head level toward the camera.

Lighting: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the makeup and the glints on every piece of metal read clearly; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
